0022600224.text: The Orlando Magic (3-7, 3-3 on the road, on a W1 streak) visit the Utah Jazz (1-10, on a nine-game losing streak) with both teams sitting near the bottom of the East and West. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Izaiyah Nelson, Jonathan Isaac, and Noah Penda, with Jamal Cain and Tristan da Silva listed as day-to-day, while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr., Jusuf Nurkic, and Lauri Markkanen, with Keyonte George also day-to-day. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the Magic won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 120-117 victory in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
